notes.title: Update: Chinese is now in the game!
notes.content:
We are pleased to announce that Chinese has been added to our game. This is an important step for us, and we hope that now even more players will be able to enjoy our story.

We have tried to make the translation as accurate as possible and believe we have conveyed all the nuances of the story and dialog. However, we would appreciate your feedback so that we can improve the localization if necessary.

Keep updating the game and share your impressions. Thank you for being with us!

notes.title: Update 09.06.2024
notes.content:
Hey, everybody!

We finally got it done! A huge amount of work has been done on the text, and we have fixed a lot of errors in the English translation. Now it will be much more comfortable for English-speaking players to play.

In addition, we have released a multilingual version of the game. We also removed the background behind the text to improve the visual experience.

I hope you enjoy it. Thank you for playing our game!

notes.title: February Update
notes.content:
Hey, everybody. Thanks to your feedback, I have noticed bugs in the game. Errors in translation and narrative line. A small update will be released in February to fix these bugs. Thank you all for playing.

P.S. In February will be released a demo version of the second season, which will include the first 3 episodes. It will be free of charge.
